<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsd:schema xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/b1f88283-0bfd-4eb2-8277-c94b48f0924e.xsd" xmlns:ibmbpm="http://lombardi.ibm.com/schema/" targetNamespace="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/b1f88283-0bfd-4eb2-8277-c94b48f0924e.xsd">
  <xsd:element name="reorderQuantityRequest" type="reorderQuantityRequest"/>
  <xsd:element name="reorderQuantityResponse" type="reorderQuantityResponse"/>
  <xsd:complexType name="reorderQuantityRequest">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="body" type="bodyType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='reorderQuantityRequest']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='body']"/>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="reorderQuantityResponse">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="reorderQuantity" type="reorderQuantity_200Type" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='reorderQuantityResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='reorderQuantity']">
        <xsd:annotation alternateOldName="reorderQuantity_200" optional="true" responseCode="200">
          <xsd:documentation>Successful execution</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="bodyType">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="forecast" type="xsd:int">
        <xsd:annotation format="int32">
          <xsd:documentation>Forecast Quantity next month</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element name="historic_data" type="xsd:int">
        <xsd:annotation format="int32">
          <xsd:documentation>Quantity sold last month</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element name="current_inventory" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double">
          <xsd:documentation>Current Inventory</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="reorderQuantity_200Type">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="reasoning" type="xsd:string"/>
      <xsd:element name="reorder_quantity" type="xsd:int">
        <xsd:annotation format="int32"/>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
</xsd:schema>
